story: Before UGC, I was already working in front of a camera and behind social media accounts. While studying Computer Engineering at UPC, I ran the social media of the Barcelona School of Informatics, and for almost two years I hosted and produced more than 50 live streams for La Lanza de Plata. Then came the Rivals D&D broadcasts and GoIT's webinars.

I filmed my first video in 2023 for Decathlon, where I worked as a running specialist: on my phone, with no mic, in my garage at home. I learned the almost one-minute script by heart because cutting never crossed my mind. What I did have was a huge urge to share what I knew about running shoes.

In April 2024 I started doing this full time, while studying Communication at UOC. Today I work like a production company for businesses and agencies: with my team, I handle the whole process, from strategy and script to filming and editing. That's over 1,000 videos for more than 300 brands, such as Just Eat, Revolut, Marvel Snap and Daikin.
One thing hasn't changed since that first video: I still enjoy it every time I step in front of the camera.

how.d: Many brands come back. We've been working with Apple Tree for 31 months, with Dogfy Diet for two years and with Reactiva Online for 15 months.
You get the proposal within 2 working days and most projects are ready in 5–7. If it's urgent, we adapt.
I don't just show how a video looks, but what it achieves: like MasterD's 390 conversions on TikTok Ads or Dogfy Diet's leads, converting at 15%.

guide.h1: What UGC is and how to use it in your business
guide.lead: UGC (User Generated Content) is content where a real person talks about a product the way a customer would. I've been filming UGC videos for brands since 2023: in this guide I explain what it is, what it's for and how it's made, without the jargon.
guide.author_bio: UGC creator and video producer in Barcelona. 1,000+ videos for 300+ brands.

p: A UGC video is a video where a person, usually filmed vertically and talking to camera, shares their experience with a product or service. It doesn't look like a typical ad: it looks like a recommendation.

UGC started as whatever customers posted on their own. Today brands commission it from UGC creators, who film that kind of video professionally: with a script, good light and good sound, and with a clear goal (selling, getting known or explaining something).

list: Ads on Meta Ads (Instagram and Facebook) and TikTok Ads: it's the format closest to what people already watch on those platforms.
The brand's social media: to post consistently and get the business recognised.
The website and product pages: to explain how something works and build trust before people buy.

sections.h: Why do UGC videos work in ads?
p: Because they don't interrupt: they look like just another video in the feed. A real person speaking clearly builds more trust than a heavily produced ad. And since they're quick to film, you can make several versions and test which works best.
I do it with the 3×3 method: 3 ads with 3 hooks each, 9 versions to test. For MasterD, the main creative of a TikTok Ads series got 390 conversions in 3 months.

sections.h: What's the difference between UGC and influencers?
p: An influencer posts the video on their own profile, and what you pay for is reaching their audience. A UGC creator films the video for the brand to post: in its ads, on its social media or on its website.

That's why with UGC the creator's follower count doesn't matter; what matters is that the video works. On your social media and website you can use it with no time limit; for paid ads, usage is licensed for set periods.

sections.h: How is a UGC video made?
p: This is how I do it, in 5–7 working days:
ol: Call: you tell me about your business, what you sell and to whom.
Script: I send it over and you approve it before filming.
Production: I film at your business or with your product, and my team edits.
Delivery: you get the videos ready to post, changes included.

sections.h: How much does a UGC video cost?
p: It depends on how many videos you need, where they're filmed and where you'll use them. I work from a single video and send you a fixed quote within 24 h, no strings attached. If you're not sure where to start, get your free proposal: I'll tell you which 3 videos your business needs.
